name: glosshub
description: Development commands, browser tests and the site's assembly script for GlossHub. The site itself has no npm dependencies.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:check && npm run build && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:check: clojure -M:check && node target/check/check.js texts test/fixtures && node target/check/check.js --round-trip texts test/fixtures
